description: This file implements methods for the FunctionSchema class within the ATen component of PyTorch, handling schema dumping, cloning with real types, aliasing logic, type mapping, schema compatibility checks, and string representation.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Represents the schema (signature) of a function, including argument and return types, name, overload, and aliasing information. Provides methods for validation, cloning, and string representation.

methods.name: void dump() const
methods.description: Outputs the string representation of the schema to std::cout.

methods.name: const std::vector<Argument> & getCorrectList(SchemaArgType type) const
methods.description: Returns a list of arguments or return arguments depending on the specified SchemaArgType.

methods.name: FunctionSchema cloneWithRealTypes(bool with_symint) const
methods.description: Creates a copy of the schema with argument and return types replaced by their real types, optionally considering symbolic integers.

methods.name: bool canAliasTypeSetsAlias(const std::optional<AliasTypeSet> & lhs,const std::optional<AliasTypeSet> & rhs) const
methods.description: Determines if two alias type sets can be considered aliases.

methods.name: std::optional<AliasTypeSet> getAliasTypeSetContainedTypes(const std::optional<AliasTypeSet> & aliasTypeSet) const
methods.description: Returns all contained types within an alias type set, recursively.

methods.name: std::optional<AliasTypeSet> mapTypeToAliasTypeSet(const TypePtr & type) const
methods.description: Maps a given type to a set of alias types, considering various type kinds like List, Dict, Union, Tuple, etc.

methods.name: bool may_alias(const SchemaArgument & lhs,const SchemaArgument & rhs) const
methods.description: Checks if two schema arguments may alias based on their types and alias info.

methods.name: bool may_contain_alias(const SchemaArgument & lhs,const SchemaArgument & rhs,bool bidirectional) const
methods.description: Checks if two schema arguments may contain aliasing, considering containments and wildcards.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Serializes a FunctionSchema to an output stream for readable representation.

methods.name: Argument::isBackwardCompatibleWith
methods.description: Checks if an argument is backward compatible with an older argument, considering types, default values, and alias info.

methods.name: Argument::isForwardCompatibleWith
methods.description: Checks if an argument is forward compatible with an older argument, considering types, default values, and alias info.

methods.name: FunctionSchema::formatTypeMismatchMsg
methods.description: Generates an error message for type mismatches with details about expected and actual types.

methods.name: FunctionSchema::isBackwardCompatibleWith
methods.description: Checks if the current schema is backward compatible with an older schema, including arguments, return types, and schema properties.

methods.name: FunctionSchema::isForwardCompatibleWith
methods.description: Checks if the current schema is forward compatible with an older schema, including arguments and container types.

methods.name: FunctionSchema::findErrorInKwargs
methods.description: Validates keyword arguments against the schema, reporting unknown or duplicated arguments.

methods.name: FunctionSchema::cloneWithRemappedTypes
methods.description: Creates a clone of the schema with all argument and return types remapped via a provided function.

methods.name: bool isSubtypeOfList(ArrayRef<Argument> child,ArrayRef<Argument> parent,std::ostream * why_not)
methods.description: Checks covariant subtyping for lists of arguments.

methods.name: FunctionSchema::isSubtypeOf
methods.description: Checks schema subtyping, with covariance on arguments and covariance on return types.
